## Open-access publications.

*Quantitative Finance with R.* An evolving collection of open-access online books:

- [***Credit Risk Modeling with R: A Step-by-Step Guide for Business, Finance, and Risk Analysts.***](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_arf/) *(pre-print version).* 2026. Applied and reproducible coverage of credit scoring, structural default models, credit spreads and CDS valuation, dependence modeling with copulas, portfolio credit risk, and climate-related credit risk.
- [***Financial Econometrics with R.***](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_emf/) 2026. Applied treatment of economic and financial time-series forecasting, machine-learning methods, GARCH volatility models, and CAPM and Fama-French asset-pricing models, with emphasis on validation, model comparison, and interpretation.
- [***Options and VaR with R.***](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_if/) 2024. Practical introduction to derivative payoffs, option properties, put-call parity, binomial valuation, Wiener processes, Value-at-Risk estimation, and portfolio allocation.
- [***Financial Modeling with R.***](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_pmf/) 2026. Reproducible guide to acquiring, visualizing, and analyzing financial data, covering returns, trading strategies, asset pricing, portfolio allocation, market risk, and blockchain applications.

[***Supervision Guide.***](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/supervision/) 2026. Open-access academic guide to designing, writing, presenting, and managing undergraduate and postgraduate research, software, and consultancy projects, including the responsible use of generative AI.

## Open source software.

1. *Credit risk in public firms.* 2023. First stage collaborators: Hernán González Aguilera, and Ramiro Castellanos Barrón. Available at [https://github.com/mlozanoqf/RunwayFinance](https://github.com/mlozanoqf/RunwayFinance)
1. *European options strategy analyzer.* 2026. Author: Dr. Martín Lozano. Interactive app to design and evaluate European options strategies, combining payoff visualization with scenario-based profit and risk analysis. Available at [https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/opstr/](https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/opstr/)
1. *Mini Crypto Miner: Eco-Friendly Proof-of-Work Challenge.* 2026. Author: Dr. Martín Lozano. Educational simulation of proof-of-work mining where users test nonces against a hash target in a local, no-crypto environment to understand mining logic and resource constraints. Available at [https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/pass/](https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/pass/)
